summary.intent: Switch from the PR #532 worktree to the main tree on branch chore/ci-fix-landing-ipfs-pin (PR #534), then resolve all open PR review comments on that branch.
summary.outcome: Removed the p54 worktree cleanly, resolved two valid Greptile review findings in deploy-landing.yml by hardening the IPFS pinning script against set -e/pipefail edge cases, validated with actionlint and zizmor, and pushed the fix.

repo: CipherBox uses multiple git worktrees (p52, p54, p55) for parallel PR work; worktrees are named by phase number.
deploy-landing.yml uses an ssh-action shell context — shellcheck SC2148 (missing shebang) is a false positive when linting extracted snippets; actionlint's embedded shellcheck is authoritative.
zizmor and actionlint are the canonical validators for GitHub Actions workflow changes in this repo.

code.finding: Under `set -e`, a failing in-container `rm -rf` cleanup aborts the script before `echo "${CID}"`, losing the CID for an already-committed pin and leaving DNSLink stale. Cleanup must be moved after or made non-fatal.
`docker ps … | head -1` can send SIGPIPE to `docker ps` (exit 141) under pipefail, aborting before the empty-KUBO guard fires. Needs pipefail-safe handling.

workflow: Greptile automated review correctly identified real robustness bugs in shell-within-workflow scripts — worth triaging its findings rather than dismissing them.
For workflow-only changes, `pnpm test` is not applicable; actionlint + zizmor is the correct validation gate.

friction: The user had to manually run `git switch chore/ci-fix-landing-ipfs-pin` after the worktree removal — the assistant's remove+checkout step apparently landed on the wrong branch.
open_items: PR #532 (feat/e2e-test-infra-typing) and PR #533 (p52 worktree) are still open and unaddressed in this session.
The p55 worktree's purpose and branch were not identified — may need follow-up.
